backstageHostname.description: The portal's host, which kore derives (ADR 0111, ADR 0133): backstage.<organizationId>.<platformDomain> while platform-shared-gateway is on, where the shared Gateway serves it, and backstage.<platformDomain> otherwise. The route, the base URL, the sign-in redirect and the Keycloak client's redirect URIs take this one value.

keycloakHostname.description: The Keycloak host the sign-in proxy's OIDC issuer and metadata URL name: the same value the Keycloak chart serves (ADR 0133).

gatewayClassName.description: The GatewayClass the portal's own Gateway uses, which kore derives from the ingress feature flag and passes in. With none set, or with sharedGateway set, the chart renders no Gateway of its own.

issuer.description: The ClusterIssuer that signs the portal host's certificate.

sharedGateway.description: The shared platform Gateway the portal's route attaches to, which kore passes only while platform-shared-gateway is on (ADR 0133). The route's host is backstageHostname, so no domain is passed. Passing it drops the chart's own Gateway, certificate and route. Without it no shared route renders.

localCa.description: The ConfigMap, in this namespace, that carries the local CA the portal's pods trust (keys ca.crt and bundle.crt), which kore applies and passes only while platform-dns is on (ADR 0132). Without it nothing is mounted.

image.description: The sign-in proxy image, by digest.
